name: gridfinity-customizer
description: Ordinus — web-based visual design tool for creating custom Gridfinity modular storage layouts with drag-and-drop, reference images, and bill of materials generation
author: mgomezdev

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=app && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=app && npm run typecheck --workspace=server
scripts.test:run: npm run test:run --workspace=app && npm run test --workspace=server
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace=app && npm run test:coverage --workspace=server
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
